event.title: Judge Blocks Trump Administration's Plan to Move FBI Headquarters
event.canonical_title: Judge Blocks Trump Administration's Plan to Move FBI Headquarters
event.summary: A US judge has blocked the Trump administration's plans to relocate the FBI headquarters to a federal office building in Washington, D.C. The administration sought to abandon a previously approved site selected under the Biden administration in favor of repurposing another building nearby.

timeline.title: Judge Halts Trump Administration's Plan to Change FBI Headquarters Relocation
timeline.summary: A judge has blocked the Trump administration's efforts to abandon plans for relocating the FBI headquarters to a site approved by the Biden administration. The administration had proposed repurposing a different building in Washington, D.C., instead of moving to the selected site in Maryland. This ruling is part of an ongoing dispute regarding the future location of the FBI's main office.
key_facts: Trump administration attempted to scrap FBI headquarters relocation plans.
Judge ruled against the administration's proposal to repurpose another building.
The relocation plan was approved under the Biden administration.
